title: Chapter 1315 - 3: The Shisan Of The Chaos Void
content:
Chapter 1315 - 3: The Shisan Of The Chaos Void

Chapter 1315: Chapter 3: The Shisan of the Chaos Void

"I can’t feel the existence of the gourd?"

The towering figure’s pupils contracted.

All seven special artifacts were crafted by It, naturally under absolute control.

With just a thought, regardless of place, with or without an inheritor, they would return to It.

The so-called special artifacts were originally meant for cultivating inheritors.

The true master is still Itself.

Though inheritors of the past seemed like the master in name, they were mere passersby in essence.

But now?

The towering figure retracting the seven special artifacts, the jade gourd representing the universe within, didn’t even appear.

It couldn’t even perceive where exactly the jade gourd was.

To be precise.

The towering figure sensed that the jade gourd was still in this Chaos Void.

However, its exact location felt vague, as if isolated from all causal connections.

"What on earth is happening?" the towering figure wondered.

The means to achieve this, making It unable to pinpoint the jade gourd’s location.

Very likely at the hands of a thirteenth-tier time life form, though It knows all the time life forms in the Chaos Void.

They understand each other well.

Logically, it’s impossible for them to take the special artifacts crafted to nurture inheritors without cause.

After all, the thirteenth-tier legacy in the special artifacts follows Its path, of little use to other time life forms.

Moreover, the seven time life forms of the Chaos Void exchanged their paths long ago, making it unnecessary to take Its jade gourd.

As for time life forms outside the Chaos Void? The Chaos Void’s consciousness operates instinctively, and even a Time Lord would be instantly noticed if They dared invade.

"Let’s see."

The towering figure’s expression was slightly grave.

Begins observing the timeline.

Time lines visible to thirteenth-tier time life forms aren’t limited to future lines.

There’s also the past timeline.

Only the past is set.

No variables exist.

Hence, thirteenth-tier time life forms rarely observe past timelines.

Almost all focus is on observing future timelines.

However, the scene currently facing the towering figure forces It to view this Chaos Void’s past timeline.

By observing the past timeline, confirming the final time node when the jade gourd disappeared, then following the timeline to ultimately determine where the jade gourd fell.

Buzzing ~ the timeline starts to reverse.

One thousand years, two thousand years, three thousand years...

Ten thousand years, twenty thousand years...

Finally, at a point just under twenty thousand years ago, the jade gourd was found within a nascent universe.

At this moment, the jade gourd was still in its primitive state, crimson in color.

"He became the inheritor?"

The towering figure’s gaze fell upon Lin Yuan, who had just obtained the jade gourd.

Zoom—

After pinpointing the jade gourd’s location.

The towering figure continued to trace forward along the timeline.

"How is the growth speed so fast?" The towering figure only took a brief look.

Not believing the jade gourd It couldn’t sense was related to Lin Yuan.

After all, Lin Yuan was too weak when he acquired the jade gourd.

But as the timeline moved forward.

The frightening speed of Lin Yuan’s growth astonished the towering figure.

Taking only a few thousand years to attain the pinnacle of the Chaos Realm.

"Sky Void Tripod?"

The towering figure discovered the Sky Void Tripod obtained by Lin Yuan.

Showing no surprise.

The Sky Void Tripod’s master is also one of the seven time life forms of the Chaos Void.

"Hmm?"

The towering figure continued observing.

The timeline swiftly passed to the present.

Lin Yuan’s strength continued to grow with no limits.

Until over ten thousand years ago.

Something about Lin Yuan must have transformed.

Before this, the towering figure could always pinpoint the jade gourd’s location.

It resided in Lin Yuan’s internal universe.

But at the time node over ten thousand years ago.

The towering figure clearly sensed a transformation in Lin Yuan’s internal universe aura.

Then all cause was isolated, everything severed.

Its perception of the jade gourd was completely blocked at this moment.

Until now.

The towering figure couldn’t specifically sense the jade gourd’s location.

"Is it him?"

The towering figure’s gaze reached the current timeline, looking towards Lin Yuan’s location from afar.

"What means did he use to sever my perception?" The towering figure was inevitably perplexed.

As a time life born from the Chaos Void, nothing inside the Chaos Void could be hidden from It, even within those nascent universes, shielded by the rules of the Chaos Void.

Many secrets inside couldn’t hide from It.

Yet the towering figure watched as its perception of the jade gourd was severed entirely by Lin Yuan.

"Keep watching."

Incredible as it was, the towering figure didn’t act rashly.

But immediately started observing Lin Yuan’s future timeline.

Lin Yuan’s prowess hadn’t been fully unveiled in the Chaos Void.

Though his few moves far surpassed the invincible Great Saints of Chaos Void’s history.

But to a time life as transcendent as the towering figure, that wasn’t much.

Simply from past timelines, Lin Yuan’s true power couldn’t be ascertained.

Whoosh.

The timeline flowed like water.

Rapidly unfolding into the future.

"This?"

After just a quick glance, the towering figure saw tens of thousands of years ahead.

In this timeline, Lin Yuan smoothly crossed into the thirteenth tier, becoming a time life.

"Any random timeline, he becomes a time life?"

Though the towering figure was somewhat stunned, as future changes are limitless, and timelines infinite.

Randomly choosing a timeline showed the other party becoming a thirteenth-tier time life.

The towering figure felt lucky but continued to pry further into the distant future.
